description:
Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)

Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Summary**
---------------

Linux L2 - RHEL, SUSE, CentOS, Hybrid Cloud / Cloud Business Unit Infrastructure, Shell/Bash Scripting, Ansible, VMware, Storage Integration, LVM, Clustering, Network Protocols, Monitoring Tools.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Linux HCBU (L3) Key Responsibilities: Linux System Operations & Administration: Perform day-to-day administration, installation, configuration, user access management, patch updates, and system maintenance for RHEL/CentOS/SUSE environments across hybrid cloud environments. Storage & LVM Management: Configure and manage Logical Volume Management (LVM), perform file system expansion, volume creation, disk provisioning, and mount point management attached to SAN/NAS storage. Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution: Perform initial triage, system diagnostics, performance tuning, and resolution for OS-level crashes, kernel panics, CPU/Memory bottlenecks, and high-priority infrastructure tickets. Automation & Scripting: Develop and maintain Shell/Bash scripts and Ansible playbooks to automate routine administrative tasks, patching cycles, user management, and compliance checks. Hybrid Cloud & Infrastructure Integration: Support host connectivity, network configuration (bonding, VLANs, route setup), and baseline integration with Cloud Business Unit (HCBU) virtualized and enterprise compute platforms. System Backup & Recovery: Execute regular baseline system backups, system image restore operations, and participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) drills and failover testing. Compliance & Security Maintenance: Implement Linux security hardening guidelines (CIS benchmarks), access controls (Sudo, SSH keys), patch management, and vulnerability remediation across assigned servers.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Technical: Linux Administration: 3–5 years of dedicated hands-on experience administering enterprise Linux operating systems (RHEL 7/8/9, CentOS, or SUSE). Logical Volume Manager (LVM) & Filesystems: Core expertise in managing LVM, EXT4/XFS filesystems, disk partition layouts, and storage attachment. Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in writing Shell/Bash scripts and baseline exposure to Ansible for configuration automation. Networking & Protocols: Solid grasp of TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, NFS, CIFS, SSH, FTP, and bonding/teaming configurations. User & Access Management: Strong knowledge of SSH key authentication, sudoers policies, user accounts, and Active Directory / LDAP integration. Non-Technical Strong analytical problem-solving skills for complex system diagnostics and OS performance issues. Effective operational communication skills for working with cross-functional IT and infrastructure teams. Proven ability to manage L2 incident tickets independently within defined SLA boundaries. Good to Have Skills: Basic experience managing virtualized compute environments on VMware vSphere or KVM. Exposure to cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, Azure, or private cloud environments). Understanding of container technology fundamentals (Docker/Podman). Soft Skills: Clear written and verbal communication for logging ticket notes, root cause analysis (RCA), and operational handovers. High adaptability and responsiveness under incident triage or emergency maintenance windows. Strong team-player attitude with focus on standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Certifications: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) (Highly Preferred) , Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) or AWS/Azure Fundamentals (Good to have), ITIL v3/v4 Foundation (Preferred) Overview Role – Linux HCBU L2 Experience Level – 3-5 years Job Location – Bengaluru / Hyderabad Job Type – Full-Time Support type - 24x7 Operational Support & Project Engagements

title: Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)
description:
Sr Administrator (Support & Operations)

Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Summary**
---------------

Job Description – Linux Administrator

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Key Responsibilities: Target Cloud Provisioning: Deploy and configure target cloud infrastructure (Azure Virtual Machines, GCP Compute Engine, Virtual Networks, and Managed Disks) to receive migrating Linux workloads. Migration Execution: Install, configure, and troubleshoot replication mobility agents on source Linux servers using tools like Azure Migrate, ASR, or GCP Migrate for Compute. Pre-Migration OS Preparation: Audit and prepare source Linux operating systems (e.g., verifying LVM layouts, validating GRUB boot configurations, checking disk space, and ensuring compatible kernel versions). Post-Migration OS Remediation: Execute critical post-cutover tasks, including uninstalling legacy on-premises hypervisor tools (VMware Tools), updating network interface cards (NICs), rebuilding initramfs, and configuring cloud-native VM agents. L2 Incident Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve post-migration Linux boot failures, network configuration anomalies, and disk mounting (FSTAB) issues. Storage & Volume Management: Administer Logical Volume Manager (LVM), partitioning, and mounting of NFS/CIFS network file systems post-migration. Patching & Upgrades: Apply routine OS patching, security updates, and packages during migration prep windows utilizing Red Hat Satellite or SUSE Manager.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

4+ years of dedicated experience in enterprise Linux Administration (RHEL and SUSE). 2+ years of hands-on experience deploying and administering Linux instances inside Microsoft Azure or GCP. Proven hands-on experience executing server migrations using Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), or similar replication tools. Strong working knowledge of Linux Volume Management (LVM), GRUB/GRUB2 bootloaders, and system initialization (systemd/SysVinit). Proficiency in writing and debugging Bash scripts to automate repetitive post-migration cleanup and validation tasks. Solid understanding of standard networking concepts (TCP/IP routing, DNS configuration, and SSH key management). Non-Technical Technical Runbook Discipline: Exceptional attention to detail when executing step-by-step technical migration runbooks during strict maintenance windows. ITSM & ServiceNow Operations: Practical experience adhering to Change, Incident, and Problem Management workflows in ServiceNow. Support & Collaboration: Strong team player who coordinates effectively with Storage, Network, and Database teams during complex application migration cutovers. Documentation: Ability to draft clear, technical standard operating procedures (SOPs) and post-migration validation checks.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Good to Have Skills: Basic understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Ansible. Familiarity with containerized environments (Docker/Podman) running on Linux. Experience with multi-pathing configurations and SAN/NAS storage attachments. Soft Skills: Structured Problem Solving: Methodical, logical approach to diagnosing kernel crashes, network interface drops, or disk-mount errors. Adaptability: Resilience and flexibility to support weekend or off-hour migration cutover bridges. Clear Communication: Ability to communicate technical roadblocks and resolution statuses clearly to the Migration Lead. Certifications: RHCSA (Red Hat Certified System Administrator) or SUSE Certified Administrator, AZ-104 OR GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, ITIL v4 Foundation. Overview Role – Linux Administrator L2 Experience Level – 4-8 years Job Location – Bengaluru / Hyderabad Job Type – Full-Time Support type - 24x7 Operational Support & Project Engagements
